chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, and Muhammad ibn Ismail, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan ibn Yahya, and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you intend to leave Mecca and go to your family, bid farewell to the House, and perform Tawaf around the House for seven circuits. If you are able to touch the Black Stone and the Yemeni Corner in each circuit, do so; otherwise, begin with it and end with it. If you cannot do that, then it is permissible for you to do what you can.
Then go to the Mustajar (the spot where the door opens into the House) and do there as you did on the day you arrived in Mecca, and choose for yourself from the supplications.

Then touch the Black Stone, then press your belly against the House, placing one hand on the Stone and the other on what is near the door. Praise Allah, extol Him, and send blessings upon the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family).

Then say: 'O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad, Your servant, Your Messenger, Your Prophet, Your Trustworthy, Your Beloved, Your Confidant, and Your Chosen one from Your creation. O Allah, as he delivered Your messages, and strove in Your way, and proclaimed Your command, and was harmed for Your sake, and worshipped You until certainty came to him.'
O Allah, turn me back successful, victorious, answered for me with the best of what any of Your delegates returns with, from forgiveness, blessing, mercy, pleasure, and well-being.
O Allah, if You cause me to die, forgive me; and if You keep me alive, grant me it next year. O Allah, do not make this the last visit to Your House.

O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, and son of Your maid. You carried me on Your beasts and journeyed me through Your lands until You brought me to Your Sanctuary and Your security. And it was in my good opinion of You that You would forgive my sins.

So if You have already forgiven my sins, increase Your pleasure with me and bring me close to You in position, and do not distance me. And if You have not forgiven me, then from now on, forgive me before my home departs from Your House.
For this is the time of my departure, if You have permitted me, not turning away from You nor from Your House, nor being replaced by You nor by it.

O Allah, protect me from before me, behind me, to my right, and to my left, until You bring me to my family. So when You bring me to my family, suffice me from the burden of Your servants and my dependents, for You are the Guardian of that from Your creation and from me.
Then go to Zamzam and drink from its water. Then exit and say: 'We are the returners, the repentant, the worshippers to our Lord, praising to our Lord, wishing to Allah, returning, if Allah wills.'

He said: 'And indeed, when Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) bid farewell to it and intended to exit from the Sacred Mosque, he fell prostrate at the door of the Mosque for a long time. Then he stood and exited.'

key_terms.الْمُسْتَجَارَ: The Mustajar (the spot where the door opens into the Kaaba)

ai.seo_question: What is the proper way to bid farewell to the Kaaba when leaving Mecca?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the comprehensive etiquette for Tawaf al-Wada' (Farewell Circumambulation), emphasizing the spiritual significance of concluding one's pilgrimage with devotion at the Kaaba. It prescribes specific rituals such as kissing or gesturing to the Black Stone and Yemeni Corner, offering a detailed supplication at the Mustajar (the door of the Kaaba), and drinking from Zamzam before departing. The narration highlights the Imam’s personal example of prostration at the mosque door, reinforcing the practice as a recommended act of gratitude and anticipation for a return.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan Bin Yahya, and Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muawiya Bin Ammar, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws having said: ‘When you intend to exit from Makkah and go to your family, so bid farewell to the House (Kabah), and perform Tawaaf of the House (Kabah), seven (circuits).

And if are able to touch the Black Stone, and Al-Yamani corner during each circuit, then do so, otherwise, begin with it and end with it. So if you are not able to do that, then whatever you are able to.
Then go to Al-Mustajar and do in its presence just as you did on the day you arrived in Makkah, and choose for yourself from the supplications.

Then touch the Black Stone, then adhere your belly with the House (Kabah), placing your hand upon the Black Stone, and the other one from what follows of the Door, and Praise Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, and Extol upon Him<sup>azwj</sup>, and send Blessings upon the Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, then said, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!

Send Blessings upon Muhammad<sup>saww</sup>, Your<sup>azwj</sup> servant, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Prophet<sup>saww</sup>, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Trustworthy one, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Beloved, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> excellent one, and Your<sup>azwj</sup> Chosen one from Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! As he<sup>saww</sup> delivered Your<sup>azwj</sup> Message, and struggled in Your<sup>azwj</sup> Way, and preached with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Commandments, and was harmed being on Your<sup>azwj</sup> Side, and worshipped You<sup>azwj</sup> until the conviction came to him<sup>saww</sup>.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Turn me as successful, salvaged, having been Answered for me with the Grace, what no one from Your<sup>azwj</sup> delegates has wished for, from the Forgiveness, and the Blessings, and the Mercy, and the Pleasure, and the well being.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! If You<sup>azwj</sup> Cause me to die, so Forgive for me, and if You<sup>azwj</sup> Keep me alive, so Grace me in the future. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Do not Make it to be the last of the promises from Your<sup>azwj</sup> House (Kabah).
O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>!

I am Yourazwj servant, and son of Yourazwj servant, and son of Yourazwj maid. Youazwj Carried me upon Yourazwj (gifted) animal, and Journeyed me in Yourazwj city until I arrived at Yourazwj Harram, and Yourazwj security, and it was in my good thoughts about Youazwj that Youazwj would Forgive my sins for me.
So if You<sup>azwj</sup> have already Forgiven my sins for me, then Increase about me the Pleasure, and Let me be closer to You<sup>azwj</sup> in position, and do not Cause me to be remote.

And if you have not Forgiven me, so from now, Forgive me before I depart from Your<sup>azwj</sup> House (Kabah) to my house, for this is the time for my departure, if You<sup>azwj</sup> have Permitted me, without turning away from You<sup>azwj</sup>, nor from Your<sup>azwj</sup> House (Kabah), nor being changed with You<sup>azwj</sup>, nor by it.

O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Protect me from in front of me, and from my behind, and from my right, and from my left, until You<sup>azwj</sup> Deliver me to my family. So when I reach to my family, Suffice me in support of Your<sup>azwj</sup> servants, and my dependants, for You<sup>azwj</sup> are the Guardian of that from Your<sup>azwj</sup> creatures, and from me’.

Then go over to Zamzam, and drink from its water. Then exit and say, ‘We are the returners, the repentant, the worshippers to our Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, Praising to our Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, wishing to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, returning, if Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘When Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> bid farewell to it and wanted to exit from the Sacred Masjid, fell down prostrate at the Door of the Masjid for a long time. Then stood, and exited’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father and Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from af-Fadf ibn Shadhan from Safwan ibn Yahya and ibn abu ‘Umayr from Mu‘awiyah ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following:

“Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that when you decide to leave Makkah to go home, say farewell to the House, perform seven times Tawaf around it, touch the Black Stone if you can, as well as al-Yemaniy corner every time you go around. If you cannot do so, then commence from the Black Stone and end there. If you cannot do this also, then do whatever you can.
Thereafter go to al-Mustajar and do what you had done there the day you arrived in Makkah. Choose for yourself any prayer you like.
Thereafter touch the Black Stone and place your belly against the house. Place your hand on the Black Stone and the other hand toward the door. Thank Allah and praise Him.

Say, “O Allah, grant salawat (favors and compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause).” Thereafter say, “O Allah, grant favors to Muhammad, Your servant, Your messenger, Your prophet, Your trusted person, Your beloved one, Your chosen one and the best among Your creatures. O Allah, grant him favors as he conveyed Your message, strove hard for Your cause, preached Your commandments, endured hardship for Your sake and worshiped You until he died.

O Allah, return me with well being, salvation, with prayers accepted and with the best return granted to anyone delegated to You. Return me with Your forgiveness, blessings, mercy, happiness and good health.
O Allah, if You cause me to die, forgive me, and if You keep me alive grant me the opportunity to come again. O Allah, do not make this my last visit of Your House.

O Allah, I am Your servant, son of Your servant, son of Your female servant. You have transported me on Your animals and helped me to travel through Your towns until my arrival in Your sacred area, the place of Your safety. It was my optimism that You forgive my sins.

If You have forgiven my sins, then increase Your happiness with me, take me nearer to You with happiness and do not keep me away. If You have not forgiven me, please forgive me at this time before I go away from Your House and my house becomes far away from Your House.
This is the time for my departure; if You allow me to leave I do so without losing interest in You and Your House and without my looking for any replacement for You and Your House.

O Allah, protect me from my front side, back side, right and left side until I reach my family. With Your help when I reach my family, then provide the expenses of Your servants and my family; You have priority to this before Your creatures and before me.”’
“Thereafter go to Zamzam, drink of its water, leave and say, “We are coming, repenting, worshipping our Lord, thanking our Lord, interested in (the kindness of) Allah.’”

He (the narrator) has said, ‘When abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, said farewell to the House, and decided to leave Masjid al-Haram (the Sacred Masjid), he bowed down near the door of al-Masjid in prostration for a long time and then stood up and left.’”
